summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing board and committee composition changes effective after the May 2026 AGM. Appointments include Richard Meddings as independent non-executive director and future Group Audit Committee chair, Eileen Murray as Senior independent director and HSBC Bank plc chair, and Dame Carolyn Fairbairn as HSBC UK Bank plc chair. Retirements include Ann Godbehere and Brendan Nelson, with transition periods. These are planned succession changes, not forced departures. The filing is a routine governance update with no special situation, so the appropriate category is 'None' per the strict conservative rule for predictable board transitions.
